title: Use Organization's Stripe Account for Location Cart Purchase
description: When a user checks out a Cart associated with a Location, the payment processing logic must use the Stripe account linked to the location's parent Organization. This will likely involve modifying the Order creation or payment processing action. This feature is dependent on the Organization resource having a verified Stripe account ID.

title: Location should retrieve Stripe account via its Organization
description: A Location resource should be able to derive its associated Stripe account ID by querying its linked Organization's geographical state, which then maps to a Stripe account. This is dependent on the 'state' attribute being added to the Organization resource.

title: Implement UI for Organization to manage saved payment methods
description: Create a new LiveView page where authorized users of an Organization can add, view, and remove saved payment methods (e.g., credit cards) associated with their Stripe Customer profile. This is dependent on the Organization being a Stripe Customer.

title: Add stripe_customer_id to Organization resource
description: Modify the Organization resource to include a  attribute (string). This will store the ID of the corresponding Stripe Customer object and is the foundation for allowing organizations to have saved payment methods.

title: Set up credit card payments for an order
description:
Implement the functionality to accept credit card payments for an order using Stripe. This will involve:
1. Creating a payment form on the checkout page.
2. Integrating the Stripe JS library to securely handle credit card information.
3. Creating a Stripe PaymentIntent on the server.
4. Confirming the payment on the client and updating the order status on the server.
This is dependent on having a Stripe account configured for the organization and a test account set up in the development environment.

title: Process direct credit card payments to Medishop platform
description: Implement the server-side logic to process payments made directly via a credit card (entered at checkout). The funds should be charged to the customer's card and transferred to Medishop's platform Stripe account. This is dependent on the updated Checkout UI and the Stripe test environment setup.

title: Display Stripe account on Organization Card in UI
description: The Stripe account ID associated with an Organization should be displayed on its card in the user interface (e.g., on the dashboard). This feature is dependent on the Organization resource being linked to a Stripe account via its geographical state.

The funds should be transferred from the saved method to Medishop's platform Stripe account. This is dependent on the updated Checkout UI, the Organization having a Stripe Customer, and the Stripe test environment setup.

title: Add Stripe account to Organization and verify via Stripe for cart purchases
description: Add a 'stripe_account_id' attribute to the Organization resource. Implement logic to verify this ID with the Stripe API. This will be the definitive Stripe account to be used for all cart purchases associated with this Organization.

title: Create Stripe Customer for an Organization
description: Implement a mechanism to create a Customer object in Stripe and associate its ID with a Medishop Organization. This could be an admin action or an automated process. This is dependent on the Organization resource having the 'stripe_customer_id' attribute.

title: Configure Stripe Test Account in Development Environment
description:
To enable testing of Stripe functionality, configure a test Stripe account in the development environment. This involves:
1. Add stripity_stripe as a dependency to mix.exs.
2. Obtain test API keys (publishable key and secret key) from the Stripe Dashboard.
3. Store these keys securely, preferably as environment variables, and configure stripity_stripe in config/dev.exs to use them.
4. Ensure that payment processing actions in the application use these test keys when running in the development environment.

title: Update Checkout UI to support both direct and saved payment methods
description:
Modify the checkout/payment LiveView to give users two options:
1. Pay by entering new credit card details.
2. Pay using one of the Organization's saved payment methods.
The second option should only be visible if saved methods exist. This is dependent on having a UI to manage saved payment methods.

title: Add stripe_customer_id to Organization resource
description: Modify the Organization resource to include a 'stripe_customer_id' attribute (string). This will store the ID of the corresponding Stripe Customer object and is the foundation for allowing organizations to have saved payment methods.

title: Link Organization to Stripe account via geographical state
description: Add a 'state' attribute to the Organization resource. This will be a geographical state (e.g., 'CA', 'NY'). This state will then be used to look up a corresponding Stripe account ID.
